The two MAJOR review findings from TASK-0007-review-03 are precisely defined and mechanically small: (1) encodeObject must call Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor on every own key and throw CanonicalEncoderError when any descriptor is non-enumerable, and (2) the submission must include captured stdout/stderr and exit code 0 from npm run compile. proposals.title: Implement core branded arithmetic types: Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires 'core completo. Aritmética inteira' and these types are the foundation. ADR-003 specifies them precisely: Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as branded bigint with range-validated constructors; Tick as a branded safe-integer number. ADR-004 requires division helpers with explicit rounding mode as a compile-time constraint. These are prerequisites for every downstream package (domain ledger, world price generator, application tick loop) and are independent of the encoder — work can proceed in parallel without waiting for IDEA-001 to be accepted.

proposals.title: Write ADR for hash function (resolves DEFINIR in ADR-002)
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADA and mandates the hash function be 'especificada bit a bit em ADR, e não pode ser a função de hash nativa'. §19 lacunas conhecidas lists 'função de hash' as a known DEFINIR gap. Implementing rand() without a prior normative ADR will reproduce the same rejected-implementation cycle seen with TASK-0007. This is a documentation-only task with no implementation risk, no dependency on the encoder, and it directly unlocks the positional RNG (which unlocks the price generator and INV-02).

proposals.title: Implement positional RNG: rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates)
proposals.why_now: INV-02 is described in the spec as 'o teste mais importante do projeto' and it depends entirely on rand() being a pure indexable function. Every namespace used in world simulation (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, etc.) derives from rand(). FASE-1 requires the price generator with two noise layers, which requires rand(). This task must follow the hash function ADR (IDEA-003) to avoid a re-review cycle for using an unspecified algorithm.
